\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

5-19. Suppose $S \subseteq M$ is an embedded submanifold and $\gamma : J \rightarrow M$ is a smooth curve whose image happens to lie in $S$ . Show that ${\gamma }^{\prime }\left( t\right)$ is in the subspace ${T}_{\gamma \left( t\right) }S$ of ${T}_{\gamma \left( t\right) }M$ for all $t \in J$ . Give a counterexample if $S$ is not embedded. \end{exercise}
